entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The new queen of Paliano, who claims to be King Brago's designated heir and proclaims her rule to the High City.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: The long-reigning king of Paliano, whose ghost has now passed beyond the veil according to Marchesa's proclamation.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: The sacred order that Marchesa says recognized her as Brago's one true successor.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city whose people Marchesa addresses and whose throne she claims.

events.summary: Marchesa announces to the people that King Brago is no more and has passed beyond the veil.
events.quote: Brago, King of Paliano, is no more.

events.summary: Marchesa declares herself Brago's designated heir, recognized by the Custodi, and vows to uphold the laws of Paliano.
events.quote: As his designated heir, recognized by the sacred order of Custodi as his one true successor

events.summary: Marchesa disbands the post of Captain of the Guard and puts the soldiers under her own command.
events.quote: the post of Captain of the Guard is disbanded.

events.summary: Marchesa warns would-be rebels that treason will be met with the harshest punishments.
events.quote: treason will be answered, as it always has been, with the harshest punishments

relations.note: She claims to be his designated heir and true successor.
relations.quote: true heir to the throne of Paliano

relations.note: She styles herself sole sovereign of the High City.
relations.quote: sole sovereign of the High City
